title: Just Beachy | KEY.co
description_expanded: Three beautifully appointed bedrooms ensure a restful stay: the master suite features a king bed, TV, and en suite bathroom; the second bedroom is designed for kids with a bunk bed, an additional twin bed, and a TV; and the third bedroom offers a cozy queen bed and TV. With a convenient tub/shower combo in the second bathroom, a half bathroom on the main level, and a full-size washer and dryer, every detail is covered for your convenience. Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, a two-car garage, and the ability to comfortably sleep nine guests make Three Bedroom 30A the perfect retreat for families seeking a luxurious beachside getaway. There are no refunds for inconveniences beyond our control including but not limited to air conditioning, power, cable, internet/wi-fi, elevator, pools, hot tubs or construction projects. No refunds or credits will be made to guests for weather-related issues or closures, including hurricanes and/or mandatory evacuations.
